The proof-carrying dossier and the abstention path
The preceding checks are useful only when their targets and assumptions stay visible.
The integration record therefore binds a source packet, competing hypotheses, argu-
ments, proof obligations, method-family results and executable artifacts by hash. It
also records shared dependencies: agreement between Java and Catala after the same
RuleIR lowering is a translation check, not two independent readings. The controller
never changes an unavailable, unknown or unsupported result into agreement.

A proof or replay closes the proposition it names. An open authority, future clause, stale result or un-
available required method keeps the dossier on the abstention path.
The worked 23EC46 replay imports five previously proposed readings. Two differ on
whether product-directed presentation suﬀices without an operational connection. The
solver finds a separating assignment and the original Python and Java programs replay
it. The installed Catala backend supplies another execution route over the same RuleIR.
The disabled live provider supplies no fresh reading. The witness identifies a legal
question; it does not answer it. The result can be delivered as a draft Java package with
its evidence and open questions, but the host must route the unresolved classification
according to a bank-approved policy. The exact contract and master command are de-
scribed in Section 6.33.
The master binds each accepted phase to its inputs and predecessor files. Failure pre-
serves the attempt and triggers a focused repair check before a bounded retry. Success
refreshes the next-phase plan. A changed source, checker, plan or allowlist invalidates
acceptance; retry exhaustion produces a report of the remaining failure. Neither a retry
nor a successful document build supplies missing interpretive evidence.

These structural checks operate on an inspected manifest. They do not discover every
legally relevant qualification automatically. The packet therefore keeps unresolved au-
thority questions as unresolved dependencies. The file also carries a notice that the
circular was superseded and updated in December 2023; the printed October date can-
not establish current applicability. The program records the clean historical edition
and leaves effectiveness unresolved. This separates successful acquisition and selection
from the further task of determining which provisions govern a particular assessment
date.
All restored pairs, retained parents, source questions and unresolved PDF-materiality
identities remain available for the next investigation. Estimating legal error or savings in
review cost still requires source-grounded answers and independent reference cases.
6.33 A proof-carrying investigation joins the methods
without joining their claims
The preceding sections establish why a single program, a majority vote or a successful
search cannot settle the meaning of a circular. They leave a practical question for the im-
plementation team: how should source recovery, alternative readings, legal arguments,
formal checks and Java generation be joined so that each result remains attached to the
question it actually answers? The answer in the current prototype is a typed assurance
dossier. The dossier is a record of evidence and limits. It is not a new legal language
and it is not a certificate that the regulator would accept a proposed reading.
6.33.1 The objects that travel through the investigation
The dossier starts with a source packet. The packet identifies the oﬀicial document bytes,
edition, selected passages, cited dependencies and the date and scope of the question.
A digest of the packet is part of every later record. A candidate that quotes the same
sentence from a different edition is consequently a different candidate, even if the vis-
ible sentence has not changed. This is the same discipline used by the authority and
temporal records described earlier in this chapter.
The next object is a set of interpretation hypotheses. A hypothesis has an identifier, an
interpretation family, the source passages on which it depends, controlled English, as-
sumptions, supporting and opposing reasons, and either a RuleIR bundle or an explicit
statement that it cannot yet be encoded. The family records a choice that changes legal
consequences: for example, a later refund may be treated as a fee discount, or the ex-
ception may be attached only to the fee component of a combined offer. Repeating the
same prompt with different wording does not create a new family.
An argument record links those hypotheses to premises, exceptions, counterarguments
and source evidence. ASPIC+ distinguishes attacks on a premise, an inference and a
conclusion; Carneades distinguishes ordinary premises, assumptions and exceptions
(Prakken, 2010, secs. 2–3) (Gordon et al., 2007, secs. 3–6). LegalMath borrows these

distinctions in its bounded graph. The graph can show that a reading is supported, op-
posed or blocked under the recorded premises. It does not turn an unresolved priority
between two legal reasons into a Boolean answer.
A method result says what one assurance route did. It contains a method family, tar-
get question, input hash, implementation hash, result hash, shared dependencies, sta-
tus and limitations. The result also names retained files: the exact request, response,
checker output, compiled program and replay cases where applicable. The verifier
reads those files and recomputes their hashes. A hash of a sentence saying “the check
passed” is insuﬀicient evidence. The status vocabulary includes AGREES, DISAGREES,
UNRESOLVED, UNAVAILABLE, NOT_COMPARABLE and STALE. The validator requires at least
two method families for a required comparison. It also records shared dependencies:
generated Java and the optional Catala pilot share RuleIR and fact preparation, so their
agreement is a translation check, not two independent interpretations.
Finally, a proof obligation states a formal proposition, assumptions, checker and domain.
It records one of PROVED, CHECKED, DISPROVED, UNKNOWN, UNSUPPORTED or NOT_RUN. A
proved obligation must carry a certificate accepted by a registered proof checker;
this integration currently has no registered proof-certificate adapter.
An unknown
or unsupported obligation must carry a limitation. For example, a finite exhaustive
replay can establish that a generated Java class agrees with a Python evaluator on
the listed snapshots. It cannot establish that the English phrase “discount of fees or
charges” includes every future rebate.

6.33.2 A dry run on two meanings of a promotional connection
Take the retained 23EC46 source packet and the paragraph 10 gift-promotion question.
The packet retains the circular, including the references to the Code and FAQ and the
surrounding paragraph 9 classification language. Retaining a reference is different from
acquiring its text: the referenced FAQ answer is missing from this replay packet. The
implementation imports all five candidate readings and the criticism proposal from
round 3, A7 attempt 08. Their origin is recorded as archived proposals. No fresh model
generation occurs in this run. Two of these readings use the same five fact definitions
and differ as follows:
1. an operational connection between the gift and the investment product is necessary
for the selected prohibition; and
2. either that operational connection or product-directed promotional presentation
can satisfy the connection condition.
Both are investigation hypotheses. Both retain gift classification and the fee-discount
exception. The source packet does not decide between them. The other three readings
remain visible, including differences in how product-type linkage relates to promotion
and where the promotion condition enters scope. Different fact definitions cannot be
equated merely because names look alike.
The scheduler first visits all five readings, then compares pairs. For the two readings
above, a separating input has an in-scope distributor offering a gift that is not a fee
discount, with product-directed presentation but no operational connection. One en-
coding returns false and the other true. The solver searches the declared three-valued
Boolean domain; a found witness is replayed through both original programs. The fea-
sibility and legal meaning of those facts remain questions for the investigation. A sep-
arating assignment locates the dispute; it does not decide which reading the regulator
would adopt.
The controller records the following sequence for the same target question:
1. two extraction methods inspect the retained circular and source anchors are checked
against its text; absent authority text remains absent;
2. the breadth scheduler retains every imported reading and its assumptions, with
archived origin explicitly distinguished from fresh generation;
3. an argument graph records the support for each family and the absence of a retained
authority deciding the disputed connection;
4. RuleIR type checking checks each restricted encoding;
5. a finite solver query finds a permitted input on which the two encodings differ, and
the witness is replayed in the actual Python and Java evaluators;
6. the Java artifact is bound to the exact RuleIR bundle and snapshot set; and
7. the installed pinned Catala backend is compiled and replayed over the same de-
clared cases; missing tools or unsupported operations are recorded as such, and

the disabled live provider supplies no fresh evidence.
The result is therefore a useful but blocked dossier. Its formal and execution checks can
succeed for their declared cases, while the authority question remains open. The host
receives an unresolved result and the smallest question that could change it. It does not
receive an approval.
6.33.3 Why a formal proof is valuable and still insuﬀicient
The proof layer is most useful when its proposition is explicit. A Lean proof, an SMT
unsatisfiability result or a checked Java/JML property can establish a statement such as
∀x ∈D :
EPython(x) = EJava(x),
(6.11)
where D is the declared finite or symbolic input domain and both evaluators have the
same fact vocabulary, time semantics and result categories. A proof of (6.11) is evidence
about translation and execution. It is not a proof that the source intended the predicate
E.
The proof assistant can also check a RuleIR property, such as preservation of the
three-valued exception semantics under a lowering step. The statement must include
the meaning of unknown, conflict, scope and dates. If a backend omits one of these
cases, the obligation is UNSUPPORTED; the missing case cannot be hidden by a successful
Boolean test. MathDevMCP is useful at this layer because it can retain named obli-
gations and checked derivations. Its success remains conditional on the local RuleIR
semantics and theorem target.
Stipula and its Java/JML/KeY route illustrate the same boundary. A contract language
can describe parties, state transitions, permissions and scheduled events, and KeY can
reason about properties of a generated Java model (Crafa et al., 2021, secs. 3–6)(Hähnle
et al., 2025, secs. 3–5). This is a promising backend for an event-heavy duty, but the
translation from an SFC paragraph into the contract state machine is still an interpreta-
tion step. A successful KeY proof cannot close that step automatically.
6.33.4 The future-circular path
The bank is concerned with future circulars, so the product must fail visibly when a
new clause does not fit its current grammar. The dossier has an EXTENSION_REQUIRED
question for this case. It names the new source passage, the absent interpretation family,
the RuleIR construct that is needed and the evidence required from the legal owner. The
controller does not select the closest historical family merely because its Java emitter
compiles.
This is a principled extension path rather than an assertion of universal coverage. A
future source is first added to the authority catalog and source inventory. Its unresolved
choices are enumerated before candidate generation. The new family receives its own

controlled-language and argument records. A formal encoding is accepted only after
its types, time model, result categories and source quotations are reviewed. Existing
programs can be reused when the new rule is proved equivalent under the declared
mapping; otherwise a new artifact is generated. Old decisions remain tied to their old
source edition.
ResearchAssistant contributes retrieval, parsing, local paper and source retention.
DynareMCP contributes a useful pattern for recording hypotheses, dependency
graphs and bounded search priorities. Tree-of-Thoughts and Language Agent Tree
Search motivate breadth and environment-feedback operations (Yao et al., 2023; Zhou
et al., 2024). None of these components supplies an oracle for an unseen legal meaning.
Codex can serve as a bounded candidate or review-question generator, provided its
output is treated as untrusted typed evidence and is subjected to the same source,
argument and proof gates. The current master records the provider-unavailable state
because its live budget is exhausted.
6.33.5 The executable master and its stop conditions
The implementation contract is in src / legalmath / interpretation / assurance /
integration _ contract . py.
The master controller is scripts / run _ proof _
carrying _ master . py; its reviewed plan and allowlist are in docs / plans / proof -
carrying- assurance- integration.md and docs/implementation/proof- carrying-
assurance/allowlist.json. From the repository root, the bounded execution is:
.venv/bin/python scripts/run_proof_carrying_master.py audit
.venv/bin/python scripts/run_proof_carrying_master.py execute
The application also exposes assurance-dossier and assurance-dossier-verify. The
first accepts a repository root, retained input manifest, output directory, JDK and op-
tional pinned Catala configuration; the second rereads a saved dossier and verifies its
evidence. The input manifest names the packet, candidate set, criticism proposal and
source files by path and SHA-256, and declares the assessment time, probe and pair
limits, required backends and proposal origin. No executable expression from a model
is accepted: the restricted expression parser and typechecker mediate compilation. A
caller can supply another circular’s retained investigation through this same interface.
The interface does not generate fresh readings, acquire missing authority text or au-
thenticate source acquisition merely by accepting their file hashes.
The six phases freeze inputs, validate the contract, exercise the method families, build
this monograph and process guide, run a deliberate stale-target repair, and execute
the full regression. Each phase writes its exact command, environment, input hashes,
result hash and predecessor manifests. After a phase succeeds, the controller refreshes
the next-phase plan from those actual hashes. If a source, implementation or plan file
changes, that phase and every successor become stale before another attempt can run.
A failed phase cannot be retried until an executed repair note and focused regression
are recorded.

The final report is deliberately capable of saying “engineering pass with retained un-
certainty.” The following conditions remain blocking regardless of how many methods
agree: an unresolved authority or source region, an unsupported future clause, a stale
result, a method unavailable for a required target, an incomparable fact vocabulary, an
unknown solver result, an unproved proof obligation, or a missing independent legal
decision. This is the intended connection between the flow chart and the Java system:
Java receives a typed decision and its evidence, while the bank’s host chooses an ap-
proved action for UNKNOWN, CONFLICT, OUT_OF_SCOPE or BLOCKED_UNRESOLVED.
An execution audit rejected the first adapter because it constructed success labels from
descriptions rather than attaching executed evidence. Its original attempts are pre-
served, and its interrupted regression is not an acceptance result. The repaired execu-
tion writes to artifacts/proof-carrying-assurance/verified-execution-v2/. The
evidence verifier checks every referenced file, candidate-to-bundle link, required obli-
gation and shared dependency; unresolved obligations block a ready status even when
the method records agree. The original controller’s exceptions for changed supervisor
files were removed: changed controller, plan, allowlist or material evidence requires
new acceptance.
The resulting engineering evidence can be reproduced and reviewed. It does not es-
tablish legal accuracy, statistical independence, complete future-circular coverage or
production readiness. Those claims require a separate evaluation with independently
adjudicated cases and a bank-approved operating environment.
